calibration_status_definition: HOLDOUT_VALIDATED means a candidate fit and a separately grouped dataset holdout evaluation were actually completed; it does not mean the model passed an accuracy threshold or is calibrated to project hardware.

dataset.title: Measured A2G Channel Dataset (CIR) in Multiple Scenarios
dataset.scope_boundary: public_dataset_domain_only; not calibrated to project hardware or urban disaster scenarios

parameter_uncertainty.method: percentile cluster bootstrap over whole training measurement groups
parameter_uncertainty.limitation: four training groups provide few independent clusters; the interval does not include unreported measurement uncertainty

identifiability.dataset_specific_offset: estimated from published derived path-loss labels with equal weight per training group
identifiability.path_loss_exponent: not estimated because the training distance range is only about half a decade and is confounded with environment/altitude groups; kept fixed at the Phase 14 assumption
identifiability.transmit_power_dbm: not identifiable from these labels and metadata
identifiability.antenna_gains_dbi: not identifiable from these labels and metadata
identifiability.receiver_sensitivity_dbm: not identifiable; no receiver failure threshold labels
identifiability.shadowing_sigma_db: not separately identifiable; residual spread combines environment, measurement and model error
identifiability.obstruction_loss_db: not separately identifiable from these grouped environments

phase14_exact.prediction_scope: deterministic mean PL; zero-mean shadow term and no obstruction term for point prediction

frequency_matched_unfitted.prediction_scope: unfitted frequency-matched deterministic mean PL; zero dataset offset

target_device_calibration_limit: No local radio instrument or project-device measurement was found. Public measurements do not supply project-equivalent Tx power, antenna gains, receiver sensitivity, per-sample uncertainty, urban obstruction, or SINR/BLER labels.

formal_network_simulation.reason: measurement domain is non-urban 3.6 GHz and does not identify a project-equivalent absolute link budget; candidate parameters are not inserted into Phase 14 or formal project simulations
